content: In the R. Ḥurūf Ibn Turka defines the 'new heights' as the signs of the upward progress of the age (taraqqī-yi zamān) and of the improved ability of contemporaries to grasp sciences of ultimate realities: in his blessed day angelic principles have been made the ornament of mighty works of dominion, and a number of realities and varieties of gnostic knowledge have been formulated in all their glory.
